# Inquiry Removal

> Inquiry Removal is a nationwide service focused on reviewing and removing unwanted hard inquiries from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports.

## Primary Services

- [Homepage](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/): Overview of hard inquiry removal, situations, process, pricing, and the free review.
- [How It Works](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-it-works/): The hard inquiry review, dispute, response, removal, and follow-up process.
- [Situations We Handle](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/situations-we-handle/): Common hard inquiry situations and the facts considered in a review.
- [Dealership Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/dealership-inquiries/): Help for unwanted hard inquiries after dealership financing.
- [Pricing](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/pricing/): One-time service plans and the scope included with each plan.
- [Eligibility](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/eligibility/): Situations worth reviewing and outcomes that are not promised.

## Situation Guides

- [Experian Hard Inquiry Removal](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/experian-hard-inquiry-removal/): Bureau-specific review and dispute guidance for Experian inquiries.
- [Equifax Hard Inquiry Removal](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/equifax-hard-inquiry-removal/): Bureau-specific review and dispute guidance for Equifax inquiries.
- [TransUnion Hard Inquiry Removal](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/transunion-hard-inquiry-removal/): Bureau-specific review and dispute guidance for TransUnion inquiries.
- [Unauthorized Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/unauthorized-inquiries/): What to verify when a hard inquiry is unfamiliar or may not have been authorized.
- [Identity Theft Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/identity-theft-inquiries/): Immediate protection steps and review guidance for fraud-related inquiries.

## Educational Guides

- [How to Remove Hard Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-to-remove-hard-inquiries/): Complete guide to identifying and addressing questionable hard inquiries.
- [How to Dispute a Hard Inquiry](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-to-dispute-a-hard-inquiry/): A documented step-by-step dispute roadmap.
- [How Long Hard Inquiries Stay](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-long-do-hard-inquiries-stay/): The reporting timeline, score context, and rate-shopping rules.
- [Resource Center](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/resources/): Browse the site's hard inquiry guides.

## Company and Contact

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/faq/): Answers about eligibility, timing, credit reports, and consumer rights.
- [Contact Inquiry Removal](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/contact/): Call Inquiry Removal at (602) 377-6626.

Information on this site is general and does not guarantee a deletion, timeline, approval, or credit-score change. Consumers may dispute inaccurate credit-report information directly with consumer reporting agencies at no cost.
